d: crispy chicken caesar salad croissants 🥗🥐 these over the wraps anyday omg 😣     recipe:   ingredients- 4 thin sliced chicken breasts 1 cup all-purpose flour (120g) seasonings (to taste)- salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. transfer to a wire rack. for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the croissants with the garlic butter and finish with extra parmesan. serve immediately and enjoyyyy    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #croissant #Recipe #EasyRecipe

d: Lemon garlic salmon pasta ✨🍋 Ingredients  Salmon - 4 salmon fillets - 1 tsp kinder’s lemon garlic butter seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - Salt and pepper to taste - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp avocado oil  - 14 oz fettuccine  Cream sauce - 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream - 1/4 cup lemon juice - 1/4 cup pasta water - 1 lemon, zested - 3 tbsp butter  - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 2 shallot, finely chopped  - 1 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder  - 1 heaping tsp kinders lemon garlic butter sesoning - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. - Cook fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain and set aside. - Pat salmon filets dry. - Rub with avocado oil, then season with paprika, garlic powder, oregano, kinders lemon garlic butter seasoning, salt, and pepper. - Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and butter. Sear salmon for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, basting with the pan drippings. Remove and set aside. - In the same skillet, reduce heat to medium. Add butter and let melt. Sauté shallot for about 3 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice and heavy cream. Let simmer for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then add lemon zest. - Add seasonings and freshly grated Parmesan. Stir until smooth. Pour in reserved pasta water and mix until the sauce is well combined. Taste and adjust salt and pepper as needed. - Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss until evenly coated in the sauce. - Garnish with fresh parsley and serve alongside the salmon. • • • #Recipe #DinnerIdeas #pasta #salmonrecipe #recipeideas

d: Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

d: My Wife Has Been Begging Me To Make This… Loaded Potato Soup 4 large Russet potatoes cleaned 4 tbsps butter 2 tbsps garlic 1/2 chopped yellow onion 1/2 cup Flour 3 cups Milk 4 cups chicken stock (divided in half) Salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste 1/2 cup sour cream 16 oz velvetta cubbed 3-6 crumbled strips of bacon Optional*** Garnish with bacon and green onion Poke holes in the potatoes with a fork, microwave them for 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Halve the potatoes and cut into chunks to cool In a large pot, melt butter over medium-low heat.  Add garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent Slowly whisk the flour into the pan and stir til slightly browned.  Slowly whisk in the milk 1 cup at a time. Then add the 1/2 chicken stock. Bring to a light simmer and whisk in the salt, garlic powder and pepper. Let come to a light simmer and thicken stirring occasionally  Add velvetta, bacon and the sour cream and stir til smooth Turn off heat, and fold in potatoes  I garnish with green onion and a little bacon and my wife LOVES IT, good luck!  Ps: I use half the chicken stock when I cook the soup and when I put it away for leftovers I add the additional 2cups to thin it out…. Personal preference, you’ll see #holmescooking #potatosoup #mealideas #cookingvideo #recipe

d: Hot honey chicken sliders 🍔✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/3 cups buttermilk  - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp cayenne powder (use less if desired) - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard powder  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  - Slider buns Hot honey sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup hot sauce  - 1/2 cup honey - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Brush over buns. • • • #hothoneychicken #friedchicken #DinnerIdeas #Recipe #hothoney #cooking

d: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Banana Bread 🍌 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta Recipes” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 I have tested over 100 banana bread recipes and after countless adjustments, these officially have claimed the #1 spot 👑 Ingredients -3 ripe bananas (brown spots = flavor) -9 tbsp unsalted butter (browns down to ~½ cup) -1 large egg, room temp -¾ cup brown sugar -¼ cup white sugar -1½ cups all-purpose flour -1 tsp baking soda -½ tsp baking powder -½ tsp salt -1 tsp cinnamon -1 tsp vanilla extract or paste -1 to 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips (measure with your heart) Instructions: 1. Add butter to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir often. It’ll melt, foam, sizzle, then turn golden with a nutty smell. Once browned (do not burn), pour into a  bowl and place in the freezer for 5 mins. You want it warm, not hot. 2. In a large bowl, mash bananas until mostly smooth. d: Eggnog recipe 👇🏼🎄 Eggnog feels like something you only see people drinking in 90s Christmas movies. But let me tell you, when I made this batch and took my first sip, I couldn’t believe it had taken me this long to try it for myself. Don’t let the ‘egg’ in the title put you off — it doesn’t taste eggy in the slightest, and in this version you make sure the egg is cooked, like you would with a custard. Eggnog 6 eggs 100 g caster sugar 750ml milk 250 ml cream 1/2 tsp nutmeg 1 cinnamon stick or 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon 1 tsp vanilla extract Meringue 180 g caster sugar Pinch salt Separate the eggs yolks from the whites and place the yolks in a large bowl with the caster sugar. Whisk together until the eggs are pale and fluffy. Add the milk, cream, nutmeg, cinnamon and vanilla to a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring well until the milk is hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat and discard the cinnamon stick. Next, temper the eggs — pour the milk little by little into the eggs, whisking well between each addition. This ensures the eggs don’t scramble! Once you’ve added all the milk, pour the mixture back into the saucepan and return to the heat until it’s nice and hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat and set aside. To make the meringue, add half the egg whites to a mixing bowl with the caster sugar and set over a pan of gently simmering water, whisking until the sugar is dissolved and the egg whites have reached 70ºC. This should take about 4-5 minutes — it’ll be hot to the touch. Remove from the heat and beat with an electric mixer for about 10 minutes or until it looks glossy and holds stiff peaks.  Pour the warm eggnog into mugs, spoon with meringue and finish by caramelising it with a blow torch (this is optional to give it that toasty flavour). #cookingfromscratch #wholesomefood #fromscratchcooking #christmasbaking #eggnog

d: Creamy Tortellini Sausage Soup 🎃 This was the first recipe of my fall soup series last year, and I’m back with an even better version! Here’s how to make it: 1 tbsp unsalted butter 1 tbsp olive oil (I use @Brightland rosemary) 1 lb Italian Sausage⁣, hot or mild 1 medium yellow onion⁣, finely diced 1/2 cup celery, finely diced 1/2 cup carrot, finely diced 6-8 cloves garlic, minced, to taste 1-2 tsp Italian Seasoning⁣, to taste Salt and black pepper, to taste 1 tsp red chili flakes, to taste 3 tbsp tomato paste 3 tbsp flour⁣ 1/2 cup dry white wine⁣ 28 oz. crushed tomatoes⁣ 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth⁣ Parmesan rind⁣, optional Bay leaf, optional 1/2 cup heavy cream⁣ 2 cups spinach⁣  1. In a large pot, heat your olive oil and butter. Add in your onion, celery, carrot, pinch of salt, black pepper, Italian seasoning, and red pepper. Saute for about 5-7 minutes or until tender and beginning to caramelize.⁣   2. Add in your Italian sausage and cook until no longer pink.  3. Clear a center in your pot. Add in your tomato paste and let it cook off in the pan for about a minute before incorporating with the rest. Then cook for another 2 minutes. 4. Sprinkle in your flour and stir. Cook for 1-2 minutes to cook out the raw taste.  5. Deglaze with white wine, scraping up any brown bits on the bottom of the pan. Let that cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Pour in your crushed tomatoes and chicken broth. Season with salt and pepper. Stir. 7.  Drop in your parmesan rind and bay leaf. Stir and simmer, uncovered, for 20-30 minutes.   8. Once finished, remove your parmesan rind (if you can find it) and bay leaf. Pour in your tortellini and spinach. Simmer for another 3-4 minutes, until your tortellini is tender.  9. Pour in your cream and parmesan. Stir until creamy. Serve immediately and enjoy!  #tortellinisoup #sausagesoup #creamytortellinisoup #creamytortellinisausagesoup #soup #soupseason #soupszn #fall #fallrecipes #fallsoup #soupweather #comfortfood #cozyfood #easydinner #dinner #dinnerideas #onepotmeals #souptok #foodtok #cooking #easyrecipes #easymeals

d: I made Bruce this peach dessert… and after one bite he looked at me and said, “You’re making this all summer long.” 🍑🤍 So I guess Peach Cobbler Crumble Pound Cake is officially our dessert of the summer. ☀️🍑 It has juicy peaches, warm cinnamon, buttery crumble, homemade salted caramel, and a rich cream cheese glaze. Every bite tastes like summer and somehow gets even better the next day. ✨🍰 If you’re looking for the dessert everyone will ask you to bring to the 4th of July BBQ, family cookout, or your next summer gathering… this is it. 🇺🇸✨ INGREDIENTS | SERVES 12 Cake - 1 box angel food cake mix - ¾ cup peach nectar - ½ cup water - 1 teaspoon vanilla extract - ½ teaspoon almond extract - 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon - ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg - Zest of 1 lemon (optional) Cinnamon Peaches - 2 large ripe peaches, peeled - ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon, divided - ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg, divided Crumble Topping - 1 cup all-purpose flour - ⅓ cup granulated sugar - ⅓ cup brown sugar - ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon - ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg - Pinch of salt - 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened - ½ cup chopped pecans (optional) Salted Caramel - 1 cup granulated sugar - ¼ cup water - 2 tablespoons salted butter - ¼ cup heavy cream - Pinch of flaky sea salt Cream Cheese Glaze - 4 ounces cream cheese, softened - 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened - 1 cup powdered sugar - 2–3 tablespoons milk - ½ teaspoon vanilla extract - Pinch of salt DIRECTIONS 1. Preheat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper 2. In a medium bowl, combine flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Add the softened butter and work it in with a fork or your fingertips until coarse crumbs form. Stir in the chopped pecans if using 3. Spread the crumble onto the prepared baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice, until lightly golden. Let cool completely 5. Peel both peaches. Slice one peach into thin slices and toss with ¼ teaspoon cinnamon and ⅛ teaspoon nutmeg. Dice the remaining peach and toss with the remaining ¼ teaspoon cinnamon and ⅛ teaspoon nutmeg 6. Generously grease and flour a Bundt pan. Arrange the sliced peaches in a single layer around the bottom of the pan, slightly overlapping 7. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, combine the granulated sugar and water over medium heat. Bring to a boil without stirring and cook until the caramel turns a light amber color, gently swirling the pan as needed. Remove from the heat and carefully whisk in the butter, heavy cream, and flaky sea salt. Immediately pour the caramel evenly over the peaches in the Bundt pan 8. In a large bowl, prepare the angel food cake mix using the peach nectar and water in place of the water called for on the package. Add the vanilla, almond extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon zest, then mix according to the package directions until light and fluffy 9. Pour about two-thirds of the batter over the caramel-coated peaches. Scatter the diced peaches evenly over the batter, then sprinkle about 1 cup of the crumble over the peaches. Gently press into the batter, spread the remaining batter over the top, and finish with another 1 cup of crumble. Lightly tap the pan on the counter to release any air bubbles 10. Bake for 55–65 minutes, until golden and the cake springs back when lightly touched. Cool in the pan for 15–20 minutes, then carefully invert onto a serving platter and let cool completely 11. In a medium bowl, beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, vanilla, salt, and enough milk to make a smooth, pourable glaze #Dessert #PeachCobbler #EasyRecipe #4thOfJuly

d: Almost made it in 30 minutes… fine, it was 43 😅 but look at THIS. Juicy lemony chicken ktzitzot, fluffy baked rice, and my favorite crunchy coleslaw… aka a full dinner everyone actually wants to eat. Kids are obsessed, parents get a win, and the best part? 👉 Leftovers = tomorrow night’s dinner ✔️ Save this one… you’ll be making it on repeat. Chicken Meatballs * 1½ lbs ground chicken (dark or white meat) * 1 medium sweet potato, grated * 1 onion, finely chopped * ½ bunch cilantro, chopped * ½ bunch dill, chopped * ½ bunch parsley, chopped * 2–3 tbsp oil * 2 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp turmeric Sauce * 1 package frozen peas * 4–5 celery ribs, chopped * Juice of 1 lemon * 2 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp turmeric * 3 cups chicken stock (or water + consommé) Baked Rice * 2 cups raw basmati rice * 3 cups chicken stock (or water + consommé) * Drizzle of oil Easy Coleslaw * ½ white cabbage, shredded * 2 carrots, shredded * 1–2 garlic cloves, minced * ¼ cup oil * ¼ cup white distilled vinegar * 1–2 tsp salt * 1 tbsp sugar Instructions Bake the rice by combining all the ingredients in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cover tightly with parchment paper and foil, then bake at 400°F for 30 minutes. Mix together all of the meatball ingredients until well combined. In a large pot, sauté 1 chopped onion in about ¼ cup oil until golden. Add the salt, pepper, and turmeric, then place the meatballs into the pot. Cover and cook for about 7 minutes, turning once. Add the peas, celery, lemon juice, and chicken stock. Cover and cook for another 10 minutes. For the coleslaw, combine all the ingredients and toss well. Serve the lemony chicken ktzitzot over fluffy baked rice with a generous side of crunchy coleslaw, and enjoy one of the easiest comfort meals you’ll make all week. 🤍 #sivanskitchen #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal #easyrecipe #bakedrice

d: Cowboy butter steak sliders ✨🍔 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, sliced into strips - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp soy sauce  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) - Smoked provolone cheese - Avocado oil for searing - Brioche buns “Caramelized” onions  - 2-3 medium yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 8 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1/2 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Garlic butter - 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted - 2 tbsp parsley, freshly chopped  - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder  - Salt to taste Instructions  - Toss sliced  steak with soy sauce, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Preheat your oven to 375°F. - In an oven-safe baking dish, layer the bottom halves of your sliced brioche buns with smoked provolone cheese. - Add a generous layer of caramelized onions, followed by your cooked steak, then top with more cheese. - Place the top halves of the brioche buns on top. - Cover with foil and bake for 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is fully melted. - Remove the foil, brush with garlic butter, and bake uncovered for an additional 4–5 minutes until the buns are golden and crisp. - Take out of the oven, brush with more garlic butter, and serve warm. • • • #recipes #dinnerideas #sliders #steakrecipe #foodideas

d: MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food
